died.name: David Brainerd
died.desc: American missionary to the Native Americans
died.last_words: Lord, now let thy servant depart in peace.

died.name: Pierre Pigneau de Behaine
died.desc: French Roman Catholic priest and missionary in Vietnam
died.last_words: Here I am finally. Here I am at the end of the tumultuous career that, whatever my repugnance, I have kept to for so long. My troubles will soon be over and my true happiness is coming, since I have all confidence in the mercy of my God. I willingly leave this world where I have been thought happy in that I have had public admiration, been respected by great, esteemed kings. I can't say that I regret all these honors-it's just that they add up to vanity and trouble.

died.name: Louis Barthou
died.cause: killed by police gunfire during the response to Alexander I of Yugoslavia's assassination
died.last_words: I suffer terribly. I am thirsty.

died.name: Pope Pius XII
died.desc: Italian Roman Catholic prelate and Pope
died.last_words: Pray. Pray that this regrettable situation for the Church may end.

died.name: Howard Glenn
died.desc: Titans of New York offensive guard
died.cause: in locker room after fatal in-game injury

died.name: Che Guevara
died.last_words: I know you are here to kill me. Shoot, coward, you are only going to kill a man.

born.name: Frederick William, Duke of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel
born.cause: to his aide Major von Wachholtz asking for whereabouts of adjutant-general Elias Olfermann shortly after being shot in the liver at the Battle of Quatre Bras
born.last_words: My dear Wachholtz, where is Olfermann?

born.name: Reginald Dyer
born.cause: In 1919, Dyer ordered the troops under his command to fire into a crowd of protesting Indian independence activists in Jallianwala Bagh, Punjab, killing at least 379 people and wounding over 1,200 others
born.last_words: So many people who knew the condition of Amritsar say I did right...but so many others say I did wrong. I only want to die and know from my Maker whether I did right or wrong.

born.name: John Lennon
born.cause: moments after being fatally shot by Mark David Chapman
